priorityList: Use Invoke Xuen the White Tiger when Zenith is available or active, prioritizing windows where the target will survive the full duration.
Use Zenith during Xuen, Bloodlust, or when major strikes are on cooldown to trigger Flurry Strikes.
Channel Celestial Conduit if Zenith is active and your primary rotational abilities (RSK, FoF, Windlord) are currently on cooldown.
Use Whirling Dragon Punch whenever available, prioritizing usage during Power Infusion or Zenith windows.
Use Fists of Fury if you have 30 Flurry Charges and Zenith is inactive, or when empowered by Heart of the Jade Serpent.
Use Strike of the Windlord on cooldown, ideally while Zenith is active or during Heart of the Jade Serpent buffs.
Use Rushing Wind Kick on cooldown as a high-priority strike.
Use Rising Sun Kick as your primary Chi spender, especially during Bloodlust or Heart of the Jade Serpent windows.
Use Spinning Crane Kick only when the Dance of Chi-Ji proc is active to avoid wasting the buff.
Use Touch of Death on cooldown, provided Zenith is not currently active.
Use Blackout Kick to consume Combo Breaker procs or when you have excess Chi to spend.
Use Tiger Palm to generate Chi when below 4 Chi and high on energy, ensuring you never use it twice in a row to maintain Combo Strikes.
Use Racial abilities (like Berserking or Blood Fury) to align with Xuen the White Tiger's duration.
Use your combat potion and trinkets (like Algethar's Puzzle Box) to align with your Xuen and Zenith burst windows.
Always maintain the Combo Strikes passive by ensuring no two consecutive abilities are the same.
